In this chapter we introduce discrete random variables, those who take values in a ﬁnite or countably inﬁnite
support set. We discuss probability mass functions and some special expectations, namely, the mean, variance
and standard deviation. Some of the more important discrete distributions are explored in detail, and the more
general concept of expectation is deﬁned, which paves the way for moment generating functions.
